items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: I never saw Faz in person.

ctx.x: Joe had a way of writing everything very simply. And he had a way of voicing the instruments to where it sounded like more than there really were. Just had that knack. And he did a very good arrangement. It was based pretty closely to the Bob Crosby, my inspiration, the Irving Fazola thing. stuff
